title: Management Trainee 2027

fails: Requires a minimum GPA of 3.25; your GPAX is 2.48 (transcript).

reasons.love: Partly commercial; much of the role is back-office support.
reasons.good_at: Some overlap via F26 (reporting); the domain experience the JD wants is not evidenced.
reasons.needs: Established company with formal training for graduates.
reasons.paid: Estimate: the posting states no salary. about THB 30,000-40,000 per month. for a comparable Bangkok graduate role.

summary: Eligibility barrier: see the gate reasons.
jd_text: Bangkok Bank is hiring for Management Trainee 2027 in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
